doc.description:
This module is an alternative to the original orange avoider for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at TU Delft. It uses a potential fields method to seek out safe green grass areas instead of relying on color-based obstacle avoidance. The module processes the outputs of the color filter to compute an attractive heading adjustment (based on the detected number and location of green pixels) and updates the drone's heading. It also moves waypoints forward when the path is clear.
The color filter settings are set using the cv_detect_color_object. This module can run multiple filters simultaneously, so you have to define which filter to use with the GREEN_FINDER_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID setting.

define.name: GREEN_FINDER_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive for green area detection.
